name: NEAR Shoemaker

hotspots.label: Inspect the landing site on Eros

parts.name: Spacecraft body
parts.role: Central bus holding hydrazine propellant tanks and electronics

parts.name: Two solar panels
parts.role: Fixed solar array wings generating 1,800 watts at 1 AU
parts.snap: Solar arrays deployed on both sides.

parts.name: High-gain dish
parts.role: 1.5-meter parabolic reflector dish for high-speed science data downlink

parts.name: Magnetometer boom
parts.role: Deployable boom isolating magnetic field sensors from spacecraft noise

parts.name: Instrument bay
parts.role: Houses the multispectral imager, X-ray spectrometer, and laser rangefinder

parts.name: Thrusters
parts.role: Attitude control and orbit trim thruster modules
parts.snap: Thruster clusters pressurized for orbital maneuvers.

challenge.title: Survey Eros
challenge.intro: Asteroid Eros is rotating below. Tap or click the glowing geological targets as they sweep past the instrument field of view before the pass ends.
challenge.hint: Track the rotation: timing your clicks when targets are nearest gives the highest resolution data.

signal_note: A final attempt to listen for NEAR's transmitter on December 10, 2002 yielded silence.
ending: NEAR Shoemaker became the first craft to orbit and softly land upon an asteroid.
